description.fun: A little desert snake that swallows sand as it digs and stores over 8 kg of it in a pouch around its neck, like a cobra's hood. When threatened it sprays sand from its nostrils and burrows away while its enemy can't see. Its nose is so specialised for spraying sand that it's bad at telling smells apart.
description.guide: A small Ground-type snake Pokémon that stores sand in an elastic pouch around its neck and sprays it from its nostrils to blind enemies before burrowing away. It evolves into Sandaconda.
description.tagline: A sand-snorting snake with a hood full of sand

description.fun: Sandaconda can blast over 100 kg of sand from its nose with enough force to wash away a dump truck, and its saliva hardens some of it into sharp gravel. It acts tough and confident, but if it runs out of sand it turns timid and disheartened. Coiling up like a spring helps it fire its sand more efficiently.
description.guide: The evolution of Silicobra, a coiled snake Pokémon based on the anaconda and desert snakes. It blasts sand stored in its neck pouch from its nose, but loses heart if it runs out. It has a Gigantamax form.
description.tagline: A tough-talking sand blaster, while the sand lasts

description.fun: Its pouch swells until more than a million tons of sand swirl around it like a dust devil, fast and hard enough to pulverise a skyscraper. It's the only Ground-type Pokémon with a Gigantamax form.
